C-WINDOWS-TITLEBAR-ALIGNMENT.IntentSummary: Bring the Win/Linux custom titlebar to the owner-final amended state: Windows renders caption buttons from the native Segoe MDL2/Fluent code points with no separators and one neutral hover; ☰ and ⚙ stay on the bar (amendment 5), «?» is removed everywhere, the theme toggle is a flush fourth 46 px caption cell (strip 184 px), and the 30 themes lose the legacy caption-svg fill rule (the white-dot root cause). macOS keeps the minimal bar minus the guide button.
C-WINDOWS-TITLEBAR-ALIGNMENT.ExecutionPolicy: Sequential, no dependencies on other active bundles; touches the M-011 renderer family (titleBar + chromeIcons + themes). Polygon rebuilds use the cached cargo target from the FIX-013 session.

Gate.Name: unit
Gate.Expect: all green with the amendment-5 pins

Gate.Name: polygon-visual
Gate.Command: Windows polygon: npm run tauri:build -- --config createUpdaterArtifacts=false, silent reinstall, cua screenshot + right-zone crop
Gate.Expect: Segoe glyphs pixel-measured against the native Explorer reference, no separators, ☰/⚙ present, no «?», theme icon a ring+half in its caption cell; before/after crops recorded

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: window-minimize/maximize/restore/close descriptors redrawn with butt caps (no cap flag) and full-width geometry on the 16-grid; names, frozen set, 1.4 stroke and viewBox untouched; the round-cap invariant documents the FLAT_CAP exemption; CHANGE_SUMMARY entry added.

T-002.Title: Amended bar: Segoe captions, kept ☰/⚙, no «?», theme caption cell

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Windows caption cells render the Segoe MDL2/Fluent code points (E921/E922/E923/E8BB) via .caption-glyph; Linux keeps the 13 px drawn fallback; ☰/⚙ handlers and showCustomTitleBar stay; the guide button block leaves every platform; the theme toggle mounts as the flush fourth 46 px caption cell (strip 184 px); one neutral hover; title-plate ellipsis; CHANGE_SUMMARY entry.

The legacy ".title-bar .frameless-titlebar-button > div > svg { fill: … }" rule leaves all 30 themes so the caption-cell theme icon renders as the designed ring+half (root cause found via CDP on the live polygon app).

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: titleBar-windows pins: Segoe code points on win32 with no svg caption glyph, the Linux svg fallback, ☰/⚙ restored with handlers, no «?», the theme caption cell, no separators — the gear assertion cites the amendment trail (C-38 N1 superseded then restored); titleBar-deep re-pins the restored handlers and computed.
M-011 summary line, V-M-011 scenario-74, train FIX-014 in 2.6.x-next, evidence.json with the amendment history and before/after pixel measurements; polygon rebuild shows the amended bar.

Corner.Expected: Kept handlers keep their wiring (menu popup, settings window, showCustomTitleBar); the Segoe path is win32-only behind isWindows with the drawn fallback elsewhere; the theme caption cell is DOM-last under row-reverse so it renders flush-left of the controls; ellipsis clip only activates when the flex row overflows.

Corner.Expected: Caption order stays min/max/close left-to-right (row-reverse); Segoe code points match the native Explorer reference pixel-for-pixel; NO separators (native has none); hover neutral on every cell.

Corner.name: Contracts
Corner.Expected: Touched files gain CHANGE_SUMMARY entries with coherent VERSIONs; M-011/V-M-011 stay the durable owners; chromeIcons keeps its TEST-pinned invariants.

Corner.name: Verification

Corner.name: Performance

Corner.name: Scope discipline

Corner.name: Delivery
Corner.Expected: Train FIX-014 records the amended decision chain in 2.6.x-next; acceptance pending on a fresh artifact.
